instances.claim: This tells me that the object had been threatened with disappearance or had lost its physical existence, and that it persisted anyway.
instances.why: "Remained" and "buoyed into physicality" both presuppose a prior state the object survived — dematerialization, destruction, loss of its body — and nothing before line 5 puts the object at risk; lines 1–4 establish only a value discrepancy and a ubiquity claim. Destruction is not mentioned until line 14, nine lines later, so at line 5 the contrast pushes against nothing in the draft.

instances.claim: This tells me that there is a bounded, fixed-membership collection of Cent objects, made identical to one another at the start, which the film has already introduced and counted.
instances.why: "Every Cent" and "Each object, initially identical" are claims about a population, but the draft has only ever named a singular readymade (line 3, "the readymade he chose") and a kind of coin — never a set, an edition, a quantity, or an act of making many. "Initially identical" additionally asserts a shared starting condition across members of a set whose existence is nowhere established.

instances.claim: This tells me that the Cents were dispersed to a group of people who hold and act on them, and that this group has been introduced.
instances.why: "Its participants" is a definite phrase standing in for a group the draft never names: no distribution, no handlers, no one but Chang appears in lines 1–19. Line 19's "marks of touch" quietly leans on the same absent group, so the closing line reads as a summary of something the piece has not contained.
